card.title: How to Fix iPhone 15 Rear Camera Not Switching Lenses Intermittent Camera

source.title: How to Fix iPhone 15 Rear Camera Not Switching Lenses Intermittent Camera

claims.statement: iPhone 15 rear camera stuck on ultra-wide or switching lenses intermittently is often caused by two camera power capacitors near the rear camera connector with cold joints or failure.
Rule out software and the camera module first; then remove the factory glue and reflow both capacitors.

procedure: Test in stock and third-party camera apps, update and hard reset.
Scrape glue, flux and reflow the two capacitors; clean and test.
card.caveats: Capacitor designators are only shown in an image on the source page. Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
